verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented, registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for subscribing to ZCode events. The closest item is remote invocation of ZCode via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram, which is chat-app triggering, not webhooks, so it earns no credit. A coding workbench could plausibly ship webhooks, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
